title: The "depths" or your "basement?"
content: I have 2 versions of the depths/basement that reoccur. I have the very common bunker type basement that usually "spawns" underneath the hotel/hospital. This basement is like some government bunker where they do bad things, i never knew exactly what it was. But in my dreams, im always breaking into this corridor and its so dark, a bit damp, and i know if i get caught im done for. It feels extra forbidden. The number 53 usually shows up on walls here and idk why, it may be random but its commonly when i wake up after i see this on the wall. The second version of the basement usually spawns off the house on the hill or the mansion place. This is a terrifying basement filled with like, air conditioning tunnels with demons in them. It can also be a bit sewer like with ladders and tunnels the same way. Im usually with a group of other people and we try to traverse our way through it. Sometimes i am alone and i pop out the vent on the "other side" to somewhere else in the mansion like a secret backroom where things are going on.
